content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-306. - Smoke free public entrances.
content.summary:
Smoking shall not occur within 25 feet of any public entrance to any premises to insure
               that smoke does not enter the enclosed premises through entrances, windows, ventilation
               systems or any other means.
(
Ord. No. 4003, § 1, 6-5-2006
)
